title: Post-quantum timeline
source_requirement_verbatim: **USA-SR-15 Post-quantum timeline** — USA deployments use the core `hybrid` suite. NIST IR 8547 (initial public draft) proposes deprecating 112-bit classical public-key algorithms after 2030 and disallowing all quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms, including 128-bit ones such as Ed25519, after 2035. National security systems are not supported in 0.5.0 (core SR-25.8).
